args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from this BASE_URL. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, reset-password and other emailed links point at localhost instead of the real public host, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set to the production URL in the deployment/environment configuration, and/or make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) in production instead of silently defaulting to localhost, so a missing configuration value is caught before emails go out rather than surfacing as broken links for users.
